label: 主地图地面底层
remarks: 无建筑、道路、水面与植物
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG for the 2D/2.5D Chinese tea-village game 茶园物语.
Style: clean Chinese ink outline with pale hand-painted watercolor fills, harmonizing with the approved references. Simple large clear shapes, controlled sparse brush marks, thin charcoal/brown linework; avoid dense texture or paper grain. Restrained ivory #EEE5D5, sage #83957E, tea green #526C62, charcoal #5C6261, pale timber #967653, bamboo #C5A36F, occasional dusty coral #B76651.
For constructed objects use elevated parallel dimetric 2:1 ground axes, diagonal edges slope about ±26.565 degrees, verticals remain vertical, near and far edges stay parallel, no lens perspective. Soft even light, modest internal shading, no cast ground shadow.
Output actual RGBA transparency outside the subject. Full silhouette, visible generous transparent margin on ALL four sides; never crop. No background fill, checkerboard, paper sheet, black background, white background, vignette, glow, halo, text, calligraphy, numerals, UI, labels, borders, watermark. No extra props, people, scenery, repeated objects or decorative clutter. Avoid oversaturation, muddy gradients, noise, excessive fiber or woodgrain, photorealism, heavy black outline and strong reflections. Preserve clear edges at small gameplay sizes.
Primary request: ONLY one large EMPTY tea-village ground base, a shallow broad natural land platform isolated on actual transparent PNG. Input1 defines quiet earth colors and parallel projection, Input2 fixes ground-axis directions. Do NOT reproduce the rectangular small plot or road.
Subject: a broad softly irregular rounded DIAMOND-shaped land island, shallow height; flattened sage-beige earth top with a few large pale sage wash patches near its outer rim, broad quiet warm ivory-beige clear central surface. A thin earth side face along the two front edges, matte pale brown. Plenty of open usable top surface for three separately placed navigation destinations. One continuous flat ground level, not stacked terraces or disconnected islands. Outline mildly organic and hand-painted, very few low-frequency brush washes. No individual grass blades.
2:1 dimetric camera: top diamond direction axes slope±0.5, elevated parallel view, no perspective convergence. Entire platform centered occupying ONLY75% canvas WIDTH and45–55% HEIGHT in wide1920×1080 composition. Leave at least10% TRUE TRANSPARENT padding on LEFT and RIGHT, all side faces fully visible and no object touching edge.
Absolutely NO roads, stepping stones, walls, stairs, rocks as separate objects, buildings, gate, furniture, people, planted fields, trees, shrubs, water, stream, mountain, cloud, fences, signage or UI. Just a clean open terrain bottom layer, no cast shadow or halo.
